headline: Board to discuss new members, a new Chair and Vice Chair, and Grants Committee membership.
summary: The Council on Aging Board of Directors will review committee reports, including 2 grants, and discuss new members, a new Chair and Vice Chair, and Grants Committee membership. The Director's Report covers building concerns, finances, and upcoming programs.
